description: Railway Corridor (LGATE-244) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This layer supersedes Railway Corridor (LGATE-192) Republished with a redefined set of attributes, this layer delineates the cadastral extent of the Public Transport Authority’s Rail Freight Corridor as extracted from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB). Changes to this corridor are subject to relevant legislation with changes published in the Government Gazette. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are admin, administration, boundaries, corridors, csadmin. It offers 13 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, data dictionary, data services, fgdb. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
